# Contributing to the tr-TR language pack

Thanks for helping improve the Turkish translation of DNN Platform! All you need is a GitHub account.

- [Before you start](#before-you-start)
- [Reporting a problem](#reporting-a-problem)
- [Quick edits in the browser](#quick-edits-in-the-browser)
- [Working with a DNN Platform site](#working-with-a-dnn-platform-site)
- [Pull request checklist](#pull-request-checklist)
- [Repository layout](#repository-layout)

## Before you start

- Read the [Turkish translation style guide](COMMON_TERMS.md) (in Turkish). It defines the form of address (*siz*),
  writing rules and the standard terms used throughout the pack.
- All contributions are made as pull requests to the **develop** branch.

## Reporting a problem

If you'd rather not edit files yourself, [open an issue](https://github.com/idumlupinar/Language-Pack-TR-TR/issues/new/choose)
and pick the form that fits: **Translation issue**, **Bug report** or **Enhancement**. Bugs that also happen in
English belong in the [DNN Platform repository](https://github.com/dnnsoftware/Dnn.Platform/issues).

## Quick edits in the browser

Best for fixing a few strings.

1. Fork this repository to your own account.
2. Open the `.tr-TR.resx` file you want to correct and edit it on GitHub. Only change the text inside `<value>`
   elements, and keep placeholders such as `{0}` or `[User:DisplayName]` and any HTML unchanged.
3. Open a pull request to the **develop** branch.

Not sure which file holds a string? Search the repository for the current Turkish text.

## Working with a DNN Platform site

Best for larger changes, because you see the translations in place.

1. Fork the repository and clone it to your computer.

   > Some file paths can exceed 260 characters on Windows. If cloning fails, run
   > `git config --global core.longpaths true` and clone again.

2. Translate or correct strings in DNN Platform under **Settings > Site Settings > Languages**.
3. Copy the files from the site into the repository and update the manifest:

   ```powershell
   .\tools\Sync-FromSite.ps1 -SitePath C:\path\to\dnn-platform-site
   .\tools\Build-Manifest.ps1
   ```

   `Sync-FromSite.ps1` copies every `*.tr-TR.resx` file from the site, skipping per-site overrides under
   `Portals\<id>\`. Add `-Mirror` to also remove files that no longer exist on the site.

4. Review the changes (`git diff`), commit them and open a pull request to the **develop** branch.

## Pull request checklist

- [ ] The translation follows the [style guide](COMMON_TERMS.md).
- [ ] Placeholders, tokens and HTML in the changed values are unchanged.
- [ ] If you added or removed `.resx` files, you ran `tools\Build-Manifest.ps1` and committed the updated manifest.

Every pull request runs the **Validate** check (`tools/Build-Manifest.ps1 -Check`). It fails on invalid XML or an
out-of-date manifest; run the same command locally to see the details.

## Repository layout

Path | Purpose
--- | ---
`Resources/` | Contents of the install package, mirroring the DNN Platform site folder structure
`Resources/DNNCE_tr-TR.dnn` | Package manifest, generated by `tools/Build-Manifest.ps1`; do not edit by hand
`Resources/ReleaseNotes.txt` | Release notes shown during installation
`tools/Sync-FromSite.ps1` | Copies `*.tr-TR.resx` files from a working DNN Platform site into `Resources/`
`tools/Build-Manifest.ps1` | Generates the manifest; `-Check` validates it (used by CI)
`.github/COMMON_TERMS.md` | Turkish translation style guide
`.github/RELEASING.md` | Release process, for maintainers

New resource files for extensions not listed in the `$PackageMap` of `tools/Build-Manifest.ps1` go into the core pack.
Add a mapping there when a new DNN Platform extension ships its own resources.
